<td style="vertical-align: top; width: 12pt;" valign="top">[1]</td>
<td style="vertical-align: top;" valign="top"><p style="margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0">Since 2020, the Company has been relying on ABVC&#8217;s recurring loans to support the Company&#8217;s operation. These loans bore an interest rate of 1.5% to 6.5% per annum. As of June 30, 2026 and December 31, 2025, the loan principal amounted to $2,665,911 and $2,629,911, respectively.</p> <p style="margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0">&#160;</p> <p style="margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0">The remaining balances are accrued interest and operating expenses paid by ABVC on behalf of the Company. This amount is due and payable upon demand by ABVC.</p></td>
</tr>

</tr>
